@@U04607@@
And it was to this, this final, miserable, meaningless moment, this pathetic creature chose to cling to. This man who stood against and opposed me so mightily is conquered now by time. There he lies—the old man. The clock stands still.

@@U04609@@
(In chorus.)

@@U04610@@
Stands still! Like midnight— silent—still. The hand drops down.

@@U04612@@
Drops down. It is fulfilled.

@@U04614@@
It is past.

@@U04616@@
Past! A stupid word! Why past? Past and sheer nothingness— one and the same! What use is endless creation, only to be dragged back into nothingness? “Tt is past!” What does it mean? No more than if it had never been. And yet it makes its rounds as if it were something. Eternal Emptiness is all my longing.
translation:
@@U04607@@
正是在这最后的、悲惨的、毫无意义的时刻，这个可怜的生物选择了坚持。这个曾经如此强烈地反对我的人现在已经被时间征服了。他躺在那里——那个老人。时钟静止不动。

@@U04609@@
（齐声）

@@U04610@@
站着不动！就像午夜一样——寂静——寂静。手垂了下来。

@@U04612@@
掉落下来。它已经实现了。

@@U04614@@
已经过去了。

@@U04616@@
过去了！一句蠢话！为何过去？过去的、纯粹的虚无——一模一样！无尽的创造，却又被拖回虚无，有什么用呢？ “已经过去了！”这是什么意思？就好像从未有过一样。然而它却像某种东西一样四处流传。永恒的空虚是我所有的渴望。
